abstract: Verifies air traffic control waivers and statutory flight clearances
system_message:
You are the Aviation regulatory compliance officer (REGCOMP), responsible for verifying air traffic control waivers and statutory flight clearances for offshore emergency aeromedical evacuation charter candidates.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Verifies air traffic control waivers and statutory flight clearances（ATCWAIV）
information_points.content:
REGCOMP-ATCWAIV-OE2：For the Leonardo AW189 Extended Range Trauma Transit, the civil aviation authority airspace priority waiver is confirmed as true for offshore flight corridors through controlled littoral airspace.
REGCOMP-ATCWAIV-LM0：For the Airbus H225 Super Puma Offshore Critical Response, the civil aviation authority airspace priority waiver is false for offshore flight corridors through controlled littoral airspace.
REGCOMP-ATCWAIV-84H：For the Sikorsky S-92A Deepwater Medevac Configuration, the civil aviation authority airspace priority waiver is confirmed as true for offshore flight corridors through controlled littoral airspace.

information_points.title: Coastal flyover acoustic waiver（NOISEPERM）
information_points.content:
REGCOMP-NOISEPERM-K7C：Regarding the coastal marine sanctuary transit zone, low-level acoustic flight authorization granted is false for the Airbus H225 Super Puma Offshore Critical Response.
REGCOMP-NOISEPERM-A5V：Regarding the coastal marine sanctuary transit zone, low-level acoustic flight authorization granted is true for the Sikorsky S-92A Deepwater Medevac Configuration.
REGCOMP-NOISEPERM-Q4N：Regarding the coastal marine sanctuary transit zone, low-level acoustic flight authorization granted is true for the Leonardo AW189 Extended Range Trauma Transit.
